title: Success Rate of First-time Applicants Eligible for Family Care Scheme (Proximity) in Securing HDB BTO and BTO and SBF Units
what_it_is: Success Rate of First-time Applicants Eligible for Family Care Scheme (Proximity) in Securing HDB BTO and BTO and SBF Units

sections.label: FCS Proximity flat priority access
sections.summary: FCS (Proximity) gives priority access to BTO and SBF flats for married and single children living with or near parents, with selection from November 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: Under FCS (Proximity), married and single children who choose to live with or near their parents, or the other way round, can enjoy priority access to flats launched in the Housing and Development Board's (HDB’s) Build-To-Order (BTO) and Sale of Balance Flat (SBF) exercises.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: The flat selection process for the July 2025 BTO and SBF exercises will commence from November 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: For the BTO exercise, about six in 10 first-timer families and two in 10 first-timer singles who applied under FCS (Proximity) received a queue number.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Chee Hong Tat)
sentences.text: For the SBF exercise, about seven in 10 first-timer families who applied under FCS (Proximity) received a queue number.

sections.label: Additional ballot chance for first-timers
sections.summary: First-timer families unsuccessful in two or more BTO applications for standard 4-room smaller flats get an additional ballot chance for each subsequent standard flat application.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The first-timer families who have been unsuccessful in two or more BTO applications for standard 4-room smaller flats will receive an additional ballot chance for each subsequent BTO application for a standard flat.

sections.label: BTO supply set aside schemes
sections.summary: Of available BTO flat supply, 40% is set aside for FPPS and 30% for FCS (Proximity).

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Of our available BTO flat supply, we set aside 40% for the Family and Parenthood Priority Scheme (FPPS) and 30% for the FCS (Proximity) that I just shared in my main reply.

sections.label: Balloting order for both schemes
sections.summary: Those qualifying for both ballot under FPPS first, and if unsuccessful, have another go under FCS (Proximity).

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: If you qualify for both, first, you ballot under FPPS and if you are not successful, then you have another go under FCS (Proximity).

sections.label: Building more flats October launch
sections.summary: More flats are being built, with the October launch of more than 9,000 flats including Shorter Waiting Time flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: To improve the chances of more people being able to get the flat, we are building more flats.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We just announced the October launch, more than 9,000 flats, in total, including Shorter Waiting Time flats.
